description: Remove reentrancy patches from WorkflowGrain and RunnerGrain, collapse handler error handling to the durable dispatcher, and clean up the epic reconcile misnomer + poll-driven sweep after #362's durable delivery landed.

tasks.title: Collapse handler error handling to the durable dispatcher
tasks.spec: specs/handler-error-propagation/spec.md#Covered durable handler stages propagate failures to the dispatcher

Remove the outer setup try-catch in HermesIssueNotificationHandler.HandleAsync (lines 50-74) so setup failures propagate; keep the background DeliverAsync try-catch (best-effort UI push channel) and the disabled-notification/unconfigured-webhook early returns. Verify RunnerWorkflowTerminalStatusHandler awaits the router synchronously and has no stale detach/in-stack prose.

AgentSubscriptionDispatchHandler.HandleAsync still rethrows OperationCanceledException when ct.IsCancellationRequested
AgentSubscriptionDispatchHandler.HandleAsync still returns a completed task for envelope-level no-ops (no projectid, no active matched subscription, empty rendered prompt) without throwing
HermesIssueNotificationHandler.HandleAsync no longer wraps its setup body in a try-catch that logs-and-returns on non-cancellation exceptions (the outer try-catch at lines 50-74 is removed)
HermesIssueNotificationHandler.HandleAsync still returns a completed task for disabled notification types and unconfigured webhooks without throwing

HermesIssueNotificationHandler.DeliverAsync retains its own try-catch (lines 79-101) and BackgroundHermesIssueNotificationDispatcher retains its Task.Run catch - the best-effort channel's own error handling is preserved

npm run build succeeds (TreatWarningsAsErrors)

tasks.output: Modified AgentSubscriptionDispatchHandler.cs and HermesIssueNotificationHandler.cs; verified RunnerWorkflowTerminalStatusHandler.cs remains awaited and updated AgentSubscriptionDispatchHandlerSpecs.cs, EventDispatcherSpecs.cs, HermesIssueNotificationTests.cs, and RunnerWorkflowTerminalStatusHandlerSpecs.cs

tasks.title: Remove the poll-driven epic sweep, add link-time recompute, and rename reconcile to recompute progress
tasks.description: Add a link-time RecomputeProgressInternalAsync call after non-wake links to non-terminal epics in LinkIssueAsync and LinkIssuesAsync to preserve the sweep's readiness behavior (link-to-running, terminal-before-link, all-complete-idle). Then delete EpicReconciliationService.cs (contains the BackgroundService + EpicReconciliationOptions) and remove the AddHostedService<EpicReconciliationService>() registration in MohistServiceRegistration.cs:98; retain the Events.Hosting using because DispatcherActivationService remains registered. Rename the full epic progress-recompute chain: IEpicGrain.ReconcileAfterTerminalAsync -> RecomputeProgressAsync, EpicGrain.ReconcileAfterTerminalInternalAsync -> RecomputeProgressInternalAsync (including the ResumeAsync:524 call site and the new link-time call sites), EpicReconcileDispatcher -> EpicProgressRecomputeDispatcher, EpicCancelledReconcileHandler -> EpicCancelledHandler. Add the private PreserveRunning/Propagate start-failure mode from D5 so terminal-event recompute reaches the durable dispatcher while StartAsync/link/ResumeAsync retain their command behavior. Update XML doc, <see cref>, tests, comments, and type references across active server code/tests.
acceptanceCriteria: EpicReconciliationService.cs file is deleted from Events/Hosting/
EpicReconciliationOptions type no longer exists in the codebase

AddHostedService<EpicReconciliationService>() registration is removed from MohistServiceRegistration.cs (line 98); using Mohist.Server.Events.Hosting remains because DispatcherActivationService is still registered
IEpicGrain exposes RecomputeProgressAsync and exposes no method whose name contains 'Reconcile'

EpicGrain.ReconcileAfterTerminalInternalAsync is renamed to RecomputeProgressInternalAsync; its successful progression behavior is unchanged (skip terminal/paused; MarkDone when no open linked issues remain; TryStartNext for running; no-op for idle; idempotent under redelivery), with only D5's explicit terminal-event failure propagation added
EpicGrain.ResumeAsync call site (line 524) invokes RecomputeProgressInternalAsync
EpicGrain.LinkIssueAsync and LinkIssuesAsync call RecomputeProgressInternalAsync with PreserveRunning after non-wake links to non-terminal epics
EpicReconcileDispatcher is renamed to EpicProgressRecomputeDispatcher; its DispatchAsync body is unchanged (resolves the epic and calls RecomputeProgressAsync)
EpicCancelledReconcileHandler is renamed to EpicCancelledHandler (no 'Reconcile' in the type name; style-aligned with EpicAutoDoneHandler)

All XML doc comments and <see cref> references across IEpicGrain, EpicGrain, EpicAutoDoneHandler, the renamed cancelled handler, and the dispatcher use 'recompute progress' and do not use 'reconcile' for this epic-domain action

Test method names in EpicProgressionSpecs.cs, EpicAutoDoneSpecs.cs, and EpicAutoDoneHandlerSpecs.cs are updated from ReconcileAfterTerminalAsync_* to RecomputeProgressAsync_* and type references from EpicCancelledReconcileHandler to EpicCancelledHandler

No remaining references to EpicReconciliation*, ReconcileAfterTerminal*, EpicReconcileDispatcher, or EpicCancelledReconcileHandler under packages/server/src or packages/server/tests (grep returns zero matches)

The recompute path retains all three required semantic triggers: EpicAutoDoneHandler and EpicCancelledHandler share EpicProgressRecomputeDispatcher's direct RecomputeProgressAsync call, and ResumeAsync directly invokes RecomputeProgressInternalAsync

TryStartNextAsync uses the explicit private PreserveRunning/Propagate failure mode: IIssueGrain.StartWorkAsync failure during terminal-event recompute reaches the durable dispatcher, while StartAsync, link operations, and ResumeAsync retain their existing running-but-idle behavior

Link-time recompute preserves the sweep's readiness behavior: a startable issue linked to a running epic is advanced via TryStartNext, and an epic whose members are all complete at link time is marked done
Wake-from-done links retain their existing direct TryStartNext call (not the full recompute path)
Draft/prerequisite readiness is covered by durable delivery of the prerequisite's completed event via EpicAutoDoneHandler
npm run build succeeds (TreatWarningsAsErrors catches any missed <see cref>/call-site reference)
npm test passes (epic specs: EpicProgressionSpecs, EpicAutoDoneSpecs, EpicAutoDoneHandlerSpecs)
tasks.notes: The sweep's non-terminal-event readiness behavior is preserved by link-time recompute triggers: LinkIssueAsync and LinkIssuesAsync call RecomputeProgressInternalAsync with PreserveRunning after non-wake links to non-terminal epics. This covers link-to-running (TryStartNext advances), terminal-before-link (MarkDone if all complete), and all-complete-idle (MarkDone). Draft/prerequisite readiness is covered by durable delivery of the prerequisite's completed event. No cross-aggregate event->command semantics are changed. The terminal-event start-failure contract is resolved: Propagate for RecomputeProgressAsync, PreserveRunning for StartAsync/link/ResumeAsync. Delete the sweep before applying the rename to avoid throwaway call-site work. AutoMarkDoneIfReadyAsync is a separate readiness entry, not in the rename scope. Workflow-scheduling DispatchService reconcile (epic #44) is NOT touched.

tasks.title: Restore turn-based serialization on RunnerGrain: remove reentrancy, write gate, and poll admission gate; add interleavable methods and concurrency specs
tasks.spec: specs/grain-turn-serialization/spec.md#Authority grains rely solely on Orleans turn-based serialization
tasks.description: Remove broad [Reentrant] from RunnerGrain (RunnerGrain.cs:33). Remove _worksStateWriteGate (line 43) and simplify PersistAsync to call WriteStateAsync directly. Remove _pollAdmissionGate (line 45); keep _pollAdmitted as a boolean flag for the AssignAgentJobAsync business-logic reject. Remove _pollAdmissionGate WaitAsync/Release from UnregisterAsync, UpdateAsync, and AssignAgentJobAsync. TryBeginPollAsync uses _pollAdmitted flag check instead of gate Wait(0); EndPollAsync clears the flag. Add [AlwaysInterleave] to GetRuntimeStateAsync and AssignAgentJobAsync on IRunnerGrain (GetSlotsAsync is already [AlwaysInterleave]). Keep _lifecycleGate for AssignAgentJobAsync state-mutation protection. Move CloseoutLostAsync() call outside _lifecycleGate in HandleTimeoutAsync (set offline + unregister inside gate, release, then closeout). Add RunnerGrainConcurrencySpecs through the real Orleans runtime, including a reciprocal-deadlock scenario (HandleTimeoutAsync fires while AgentJobGrain.TryAssignToRunnerAsync is in progress).
acceptanceCriteria: RunnerGrain does not carry the [Reentrant] attribute
RunnerGrain._worksStateWriteGate field does not exist; PersistAsync calls _worksState.WriteStateAsync() directly without a SemaphoreSlim
RunnerGrain._pollAdmissionGate field does not exist; no method blocks on a poll-admission semaphore
RunnerGrain._pollAdmitted boolean flag remains; TryBeginPollAsync sets it, EndPollAsync clears it, AssignAgentJobAsync rejects with 'runner-reconciling' when true
UnregisterAsync and UpdateAsync no longer acquire or release _pollAdmissionGate; they acquire _lifecycleGate as before
AssignAgentJobAsync no longer acquires _pollAdmissionGate; it checks _pollAdmitted flag, then acquires _lifecycleGate for state mutations
IRunnerGrain.GetRuntimeStateAsync carries [AlwaysInterleave]
IRunnerGrain.AssignAgentJobAsync carries [AlwaysInterleave]
IRunnerGrain.GetSlotsAsync retains its existing [AlwaysInterleave]
RunnerGrain._lifecycleGate field remains; AssignAgentJobAsync acquires it before mutating state
HandleTimeoutAsync sets _status = Offline and calls registry.UnregisterAsync inside _lifecycleGate, releases _lifecycleGate, then calls CloseoutLostAsync outside the gate
CloseoutLostAsync does not acquire _lifecycleGate during cross-grain calls to IAgentJobGrain
This task does not modify DispatchService or its poll call sequence (TryBeginPollAsync, TouchPresenceAsync, GetInfoAsync, ReconcileAgentJobsAsync, EndPollAsync are called in the same order)

RunnerGrainConcurrencySpecs exists under packages/server/tests/Mohist.Server.SpecTests/Specs/Runner/ and issues concurrent lifecycle and poll operations from prepared phases, asserting only allowed complete serialized outcomes and agreement between in-memory state and persisted snapshot

RunnerGrainConcurrencySpecs includes a scenario where HandleTimeoutAsync fires while AgentJobGrain.TryAssignToRunnerAsync is in progress, asserting no deadlock and correct final state (runner offline, assignment rejected, closeout completed)
Concurrency spec uses InProcessTestCluster + MigratedSqliteTemplate.CopyTo + FakeTimeProvider; no real clustering, no real DB, no wall-clock waits, no order dependencies
Concurrency specs assert only on final settled state, never on interleaving timing
Existing RunnerGrain tests affected by _pollAdmissionGate removal and [AlwaysInterleave] additions are updated
npm run build succeeds (TreatWarningsAsErrors catches any missed reference)
npm test passes (server specs, including the new RunnerGrain concurrency spec file)
tasks.output: Modified RunnerGrain.cs (remove [Reentrant], _worksStateWriteGate, _pollAdmissionGate; simplify PersistAsync; restructure HandleTimeoutAsync; remove gate waits from UnregisterAsync/UpdateAsync/AssignAgentJobAsync), IRunnerGrain.cs (add [AlwaysInterleave] to GetRuntimeStateAsync and AssignAgentJobAsync); new RunnerGrainConcurrencySpecs.cs spec file; updated existing RunnerGrain tests
tasks.notes: Deadlock analysis (verified from source): (1) _pollAdmissionGate causes hold-and-wait deadlock when UnregisterAsync/UpdateAsync blocks on it between poll calls - fixed by removing the gate and using _pollAdmitted flag only. (2) Reciprocal Runner↔AgentJob deadlock when HandleTimeoutAsync holds _lifecycleGate and calls AgentJobGrain while TryAssignToRunnerAsync calls RunnerGrain.AssignAgentJobAsync - fixed by [AlwaysInterleave] on GetRuntimeStateAsync and AssignAgentJobAsync + moving CloseoutLostAsync outside _lifecycleGate. _lifecycleGate is retained because AssignAgentJobAsync is now [AlwaysInterleave] and needs explicit state-mutation protection. _worksStateWriteGate is removed because non-interleaved PersistAsync calls are serialized by the turn, and AssignAgentJobAsync's PersistAsync is protected by _lifecycleGate. AgentJobGrain.IsWorkRunnableAsync is a pure synchronous read (no callback into RunnerGrain) - safe during ReconcileAgentJobsAsync. AgentJobGrain is non-reentrant. DispatchService is NOT modified.
